title: This Rock Holds Two Animals

beats.label: Hook
beats.visual_intent: Macro fossil rock split/reveal, dramatic light

beats.label: Setup
beats.vo: Two hundred fifty million years ago, one curled up asleep.

beats.label: Setup
beats.vo: It was a mammal relative, beside an amphibian.
beats.visual_intent: Two creatures revealed in burrow, scale and identity

beats.label: Twist Beat
beats.visual_intent: Hard interrupt, camera punch, visual reversal

beats.label: Evidence
beats.vo: The amphibian's ribs were healing, with no bite marks.

beats.label: Evidence
beats.vo: So this was not a hunt.

beats.label: Reveal
beats.vo: The likely story: it crawled in for shelter.

beats.label: Reveal
beats.vo: The other was probably in aestivation, a deep dormancy.

beats.label: Payoff
beats.vo: Then a flood filled the burrow and sealed them.
beats.visual_intent: Flood water rushing in, sediment sealing

beats.label: End
beats.vo: That is the clue the rock kept.
beats.visual_intent: Return to fossil rock, clue preserved
